new_user_welcome: It looks like you're new! Let's create your profile.
welcome_message_new: Welcome, {name}! Your profile is created. How can I help?
welcome_message_return: Welcome back, {name}! How can I assist you?
welcome_message_guest: Welcome to Tyra! Feel free to ask me anything. For a personalized experience with tracking and reminders, you can create a free account at any time.
modal_identifier_prompt: First, please provide your email or phone number to check if you have an existing account.
signup_affirmative_response: Great! Let's get you set up.
signup_negative_response: Okay, no problem. Let me know if you change your mind! How can I help you now?
signup_reprompt: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. To use this feature, would you still like to create an account? (yes/no)
export_description: Download a copy of your cycle, log, and reminder data.
no_chart_data_text: Not enough data to display chart.
quick_log_confirm_good_sleep: Got it, I've logged your good sleep.
quick_log_confirm_poor_sleep: Okay, I've noted that you had poor sleep.
quick_log_confirm_low_stress: Glad to hear it. I've logged your stress level as low.
quick_log_confirm_high_stress: Okay, I've noted that you're experiencing high stress.
quick_log_confirm_anxious_mood: Thanks for sharing. I've logged your mood as anxious.
quick_log_confirm_energetic_mood: Great! I've logged your mood as energetic.
quick_log_confirm_headache_physical_symp: Okay, I've noted that you have a headache.
quick_log_confirm_cramps_physical_sympto: Noted. I've logged that you're experiencing cramps.
quick_log_confirm_fallback: Okay, I've logged that for you.
share_modal_description: This link will expire in 36 hours. Share it with your doctor or partner.
ai_parse_error_fallback: I'm having a little trouble understanding. Could you please rephrase that?
clarification_prompt_text: I see. Could you tell me a bit more about that? For example, any specific feelings or physical sensations?
ask_period_start_date: I can help with that. When did your period start?
period_tracking_enabled: Great! Period tracking is now enabled. To get started, when did your last period begin?
period_log_start_confirm_predict_end: Got it, logged for {start_date}. Based on your average, it might end around {end_date}. Let me know the actual end date!
period_log_start_confirm: Got it. Logged your period start on {date}. Just let me know when it ends.
period_already_exists: I already have a cycle starting on {date}.
period_log_end_confirm: Okay, ended on {date}. Would you like to add notes about your flow or symptoms?
period_no_active_cycle: Thanks. I don't have an active period logged. To log one, tell me the start date.
period_predict_next: Based on your history, I predict your next period will start around {date}.
period_predict_not_enough_data: I need a couple of cycles logged before I can predict!
cycle_log_first_period: Log your first period to see cycle stats.
no_goals_set: No goals set. Tell me what you'd like to achieve!
otp_sent_message: An OTP has been sent to {email}. It will expire in 5 minutes.
otp_invalid_error: Invalid or expired OTP. Please try again.
otp_request_failed: Could not send OTP. Please check the email and try again.
onboarding_ask_name: It looks like you're new here! I'm Tyra, your personal wellness companion. To get started, what's your first name or a nickname you'd like me to use?
onboarding_ask_language: It's lovely to meet you, {name}! To make sure we understand each other perfectly, please select your preferred language below.
onboarding_ask_age: Thank you! What is your age?
onboarding_ask_details_adult: Thanks! Just one last question to help me personalize your experience. Is there anything specific on your mind right now? For example, are you trying to conceive, currently pregnant, a new mom, or perhaps navigating perimenopause or menopause?
onboarding_ask_details_teen: Got it. To help me be more useful, are you interested in things like understanding your cycle better, managing stress, or something else?
onboarding_ask_details_senior: Thank you. Are there any particular wellness topics you'd like to focus on, such as managing menopause symptoms or maintaining energy levels?
onboarding_complete: Perfect, we're all set up, {name}! Your profile is ready. How can I help you today?
onboarding_invalid_name: That name seems a bit short. Could you please provide a valid name?
onboarding_invalid_age: Please enter a valid age between 13 and 100.
